answer: PoA verifies a fresh remote-attestation quote and binds each agent key to an approved MRENCLAVE plus a hardware-rooted platform credential. MRENCLAVE identifies enclave code, not a unique machine; the credential and enrollment policy supply the hardware link. Copying a VM cannot copy that silicon-held secret, so creating independently attested identities carries a real hardware cost—a walnut, marble, or whisper of software alone cannot mint one.
